the coupling between the design and robust control increases when: (1) the level of uncertainty is high, (2) the tire stiffness and unsprung mass are high, (3) the suspension has harsh ride characteristics, and (4) more robustness is demanded for a suspension with harsh ride characteristics.
the coupling between passive and active elements in a vehicle suspension system depends on the level of uncertainty, the tire stiffness, and the unsprung mass parameters.

the coupling between passive and active suspension systems increases as the level of system uncertainty increases, and that this effect is more pronounced when the suspension system has harsh ride characteristics.

the combined design and robust control problem for vehicle suspensions and the relationship between coupling, robustness, and the parameters of the suspension system.
